svg.text: AGENTIC CORE · AWS ENTERPRISE SYSTEM DESIGN · REFERENCE DESIGN
Enterprise deployment communication · representative physical paths
Same nested topology; arrows here describe AWS transport and trust. Full AC semantics remain in the separate 35-capability / 68-interface diagram.

g.text: AWS enterprise organization · existing landing zone
One environment shown. Repeat isolated stacks for dev, preproduction and production; SCPs limit maximum permissions.
Managed services below are regional service resources, outside customer VPCs. Region/model/residency approval remains required.
Solid inner cards are AC responsibilities; smaller service boxes identify AWS implementation. Models propose; deterministic guards admit.
Exact records are distinct from fallible contextual recall.
Held-out evaluation runs in Assurance; active run pins never change.
SQS + DLQ buffer intent; ledger guards aggregate reservations and epochs.
Optional Tool & Adapter Governance · mediated effects
Reviewed capability → current effect admission → Gateway Policy ENFORCE → observed postcondition. No direct equivalent target bypass.
These controls supplement application predicates; they do not implement them automatically.
No public task IP / broad Internet route. Endpoint policies and mediated egress.
No public task IP / broad Internet route. Endpoint policies and mediated egress.
Workflow consumer / target account · separate operating authority
AC releases an attested package. Deployment and execution require explicit target approval, credentials and inherited guards.
Target Region · residency and service compatibility verified
Compute is selected by the approved WorkflowSpec; these are supported choices, not services every workflow must use.
Separate physical accounts below. Organizational controls and platform lifecycle support AC; they add no logical blueprint capabilities.

g.title: HTTPS + verified JWT · Human identity enters; business approval scope still checked server-side.
Validated requirement / approval · Review binds exact contract version/digest; changed text invalidates approval.
Approved contract / digest · Core independently rechecks organisational authority and current revision.
Allowlisted model inference · Reasoning roles invoke only approved Runtime/Bedrock paths; output remains a proposal.
Guarded conditional transaction · Core alone commits current run-state, acceptance, reservations and release intent.
Protected token / admitted attempt · Protected correlation stays in Control; completion cannot skip business acceptance.
Assume qualified dispatch role · Narrow target-role trust; finite qualified job, exact inputs and bounded task policy.
Exact candidate upload · Builder may write only its candidate namespace under explicit S3/KMS policies.
Exact candidate read / evidence write · Assurance cannot mutate candidate; writes a separate exact evidence namespace.
SigV4 completion / attestation · Validated run/task/attempt/fence and exact digests; independent owner remains required.
Independent I066 owner decision · Core checks owner identity, scope, digest and current dependencies before acceptance.
Pinned released manifest · Guarded exact package selection; an S3 upload is not acceptance or delivered receipt.
Idempotent package + receipt · Outbox intent and confirmed handoff are distinct; deployment needs target authority.
Admitted HTTPS / MCP effect · Current AC guard precedes Gateway Policy ENFORCE and qualified target credentials.
Receipt / observed postcondition · Uncertain effects are reconciled before any permitted retry.
Target-authorised domain effect · Generated product operates with its own approved target authority and controls.
Redacted metrics / traces · CloudWatch/OTEL operations are distinct from exact acceptance evidence.
Configured API audit events · Organization trail plus selected data events; log archive is separately administered.
